fusions.name: Snatch Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges up to 6 tiles to the target and clamps down, dealing 12 damage with a 60% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Spit Jet
fusions.desc: Spits a jet of muddy water that deals 4 damage, then hops to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage.

fusions.name: Branch Swing
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds and swings you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Light Fingers
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
